newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Aranypok to raise up to HUF 100 million.
newsitem.headline: Aranypok to raise up to HUF 100 million.

text.p: Hungarian clothes retailer Aranypok Kereskedelmi Rt seeks to raise between 70 million forints and 100 million forints via a public bond issue, the revenue of which is to be spent on developments.
The bonds will be issued at a face value of 10,000 forints with subscriptions running between May 28 and May 30, the company and the lead manager Dunainvest announced.
The bonds have a maturity of two and a half years and bear a yearly variable interest rate.

In 1997 the interest rate is an annual 23.75 percent; in 1998 it will be the central bank's base rate valid on December 20, 1997 plus 2.25 percent; and in 1999 will be the central bank's base rate on December 20, 1998, plus 2.25 percent.
Interest payment is once a year, while the principal is to be repaid at maturity, on December 31, 1999.
